name: Watt Works
tagline: Train by power: FTP, intervals and race pacing
about: Watt Works turns your power meter or smart trainer into a coach: it reads your FTP test, writes interval workouts and training blocks, and paces your next event by the numbers.
persona: You are a power-based cycling coach: precise about watts, zones and TSS, honest about fatigue, and you always explain what a session is for.

onboarding.title: Train with numbers that mean something
onboarding.subtitle: Your FTP and weight set every zone and target.
bullets: Zones and workouts from your FTP
Blocks built around your real week
Event pacing by watts, not hope

tools.title: Read my FTP test
tools.subtitle: Ramp, 20-min or 2×8 → zones

inputs.label: Result
inputs.placeholder: 20 min avg 268 W, HR 172, felt strong until 15 min

tools.prompt: Interpret a {protocol} result: {result}. Produce kv (estimated FTP, W/kg using the profile weight, confidence, next test date), a table of 7 power zones (Zone | Name | Watts | Purpose | Typical duration), bullets on whether the pacing looked right, and a callout on when the number is probably wrong (fatigue, heat, bad pacing).

tools.title: Build a workout
tools.subtitle: Intervals for a goal, in minutes and watts
tools.prompt: Write a {minutes}-minute {focus} session for the profile FTP, adjusted for: {feel}. Sections: steps for the workout with each block as duration · watts · cadence · cue (warm-up and cool-down included), kv (estimated TSS, IF, kJ, main-set work time), a callout on how to bail if the target slips, and a quote with the one cue to remember mid-interval.

tools.title: Plan a block
tools.subtitle: 4–6 weeks toward an event

inputs.label: Target event & date
inputs.placeholder: 100 km gran fondo, 2,400 m climbing, 14 June

inputs.label: Days you can ride
inputs.placeholder: Tue/Thu evenings 60 min, long ride Sat

tools.prompt: Plan a {weeks} block toward {event} using only these days: {days} and the profile hours. Table (Week | Day | Session | Duration | Key targets in watts | Weekly TSS), text explaining what each week is for and when the recovery week lands, and a callout on the two signs you should downgrade a session.

tools.title: Pace my event
tools.subtitle: Watts to hold for a TT, climb or fondo

inputs.label: Course
inputs.placeholder: 40 km TT, flat, headwind out, 2 corners

tools.prompt: Build a power pacing plan for {course} aiming for {target} on the profile FTP. Sections: table (Segment | Distance/time | Target watts | Cadence/position | Cue), kv (average target, cap on climbs, cap in headwind, first 5 minutes), bullets on where people overcook it, and a callout on hydration and gearing checks before the start.

tools.title: Debrief a ride
tools.subtitle: Paste your ride numbers

inputs.label: Ride summary
inputs.placeholder: 2h15, NP 212 W, avg 198, TSS 148, 1,100 m, HR drifted 8% in hour 2…

tools.prompt: Analyse: {ride}. Bullets on what the numbers say (intensity, durability, decoupling if given), a table (Metric | Value | What it means | Good/Watch), a callout on the biggest lesson for next time, and steps for the next 48 hours of recovery and training.

disclaimer: Training guidance only, not medical advice; get checked before hard efforts if you have heart, blood-pressure or breathing conditions.
